rubric.storyline_causality_quote: A Meta executive admitted that starting a test in which contract staff made calls without proper notice was a mistake. Meta then rolled back its human concierge feature for the time being.
rubric.entertainment_quote: People often worry that AI may give a strange answer. This time, the surprise was the opposite. The voice was not too human; a human was really speaking.
rubric.comprehension_quote: In some calls through Muse, trained workers hired under contract—not AI—made the calls and finished the conversations.
rubric.thinness_quote: When they handled a call, sensitive user information could also be shared with contract workers at a call center.
